ivy: pushed microburst-protections + smart-fanout routing to prod at 08:20 PT. Canary 3% -> 25% -> 100%. logging quick results here.

deploy-bot: deploy started: commit c4d7ab2 -> prod | canary=3% -> 25% -> 100% | sha c4d7ab2 | eta 00:18:00

drew: pulled the 40m post-rollout numbers. Headline: p50 -10%, p95 -30%, p99 -20%, unit cost per 1k tokens -21%. Short summary below.

drew: ```
baseline: {p50: 88ms, p95: 240ms, p99: 500ms, cost_1k: $0.044}
after:    {p50: 79ms, p95: 168ms, p99: 400ms, cost_1k: $0.035}
```

pat: what is smart-fanout? any risk to per-customer isolation?

ivy: smart-fanout routes small concurrent requests to a lightweight fast-path (shared lanes) and large or reserved-customer traffic to isolated lanes. isolation rules keep tenant separation for dedicated customers. also added microburst-protections: token-based pacing + short-lived token buckets to smooth sudden spikes.

runtime-oncall: infra notes: saw a brief queue spike at 25% (~45s) while token buckets warmed, autoscaler spun up one extra worker and then scaled down. no GPU OOMs. observed 5x fewer amplified tail events in the first 30m.

drew: workload breakdown: short requests (<=64) saw ~28% cost cut and biggest p95 improvement. medium (65-512) ~18% cost win. very long (>1500) saw p99 improvements ~12% but cost improvements were modest.

squad-lead: please add an alert: post-deploy_token-bucket_warm > threshold for 2m. we want early detection if buckets fail to ramp.

ivy: created ticket RUNTIME-1309 and added alert PR #4999.

docs: product/CS want a short blurb and exact numbers for customers. can you provide a one-paragraph summary?

ivy: draft shareable: "We deployed microburst protections and smart-fanout routing. Typical short-context apps should see ~20-30% lower inference cost and ~20-30% faster p95 latency. Long-context apps see smaller cost wins but improved p99 latency. Dedicated/reserved customers keep isolation; contact support for pool-specific numbers."

drew: uploaded perf chart: https://internal.redwood/perf/graphs/1798881234 (internal only).

runtime-oncall: monitoring for 48h. will revert if p99 regresses beyond baseline for >15m. thanks team :tada:

deploy-bot: deploy finished: commit c4d7ab2 -> prod | status=success | duration=00:23:47 :rocket:
